items.title: November 15, 2026
items.summary: Google SecOpsFeaturePublisher Agent Version 2.7.2Publisher Agent Version 2.7.2 is now available.This release includes the following updates and fixes for the Publisher and remote agent:Alert lazy loading for remote actions: Remote action tasks now support loading case data on demand from the server when alert lazy loading is enabled, reducing task payload sizes.Integration dependency installation fix: Fixed an issue where installing integrations with multiple interdependent dependency files could fail before all packages finished installing.Remote agent deletion fix: Fixed directory permissions when running the self-destruction script during remote agent deletion.Publisher stability and security updates: Improved Publisher resilience and addressed security vulnerabilities.Google SecOps SOARAnnouncementRelease 6.3.107 is being rolled out to the first phase of regions as listedhere.This release contains internal and customer bug fixes.FeaturePublisher Agent Version 2.7.2Publisher Agent Version 2.7.2 is now available.This release includes the following updates and fixes for the Publisher and remote agent:Alert lazy loading for remote actions: Remote action tasks now support loading case data on demand from the server when alert lazy loading is enabled, reducing task payload sizes.Integration dependency installation fix: Fixed an issue where installing integrations with multiple interdependent dependency files could fail before all packages finished installing.Remote agent deletion fix: Fixed directory permissions when running the self-destruction script during remote agent deletion.Publisher stability and security updates: Improved Publisher resilience and addressed security vulnerabilities.
